hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|\|)\s*git push' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; CHANGED=$(git diff origin/master..HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null); echo "$CHANGED" | grep -qE '^(cli/|compose/|queue/|coordinator/|monitor/|ops/|Dockerfile\.worker|requirements\.worker\.txt|railway\.toml)' || exit 0; ACTIVE=$(python3 scripts/wait_for_worker.py --once 2>&1); STATUS=$?; if [ $STATUS -ne 0 ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"WARNING: $ACTIVE Pushing will redeploy the worker and kill the active build. Only proceed if the build is stuck.\"}}"; fi

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE 'web/src/.*\.(ts|js)$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"web/src/ file changed: check whether tests in web/tests/unit/ need updating. Run: cd web && npm test"}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE '(queue|cli|compose)/.*\.py$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Pipeline Python file changed. Run the scoped pytest file for it before claiming done."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE 'web/src/routes/(admin|ops-api)\.ts$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Admin or ops-api route changed. Verify: (1) requireAdmin or bearer auth middleware present, (2) validateCsrfToken on every POST route, (3) no data exposure without auth."}}' || true
